name: Kaise Mujhe Tum Mil Gaye
description: Amruta is a romantic who believes in the bond of love and marriage, while Virat bears the scars of a broken relationship. Will this contrasting duo fall in love against all odds?

videos.title: Amruta visits Virat for work
videos.overview: Amruta and her brother Harsh wish their parents Bhavani and Jayesh on their wedding anniversary. Jayesh tells Ishika that he loves only her. Later, Amruta visits Virat Singh Ahuja to get his signature.

videos.title: Amruta attempts to talk to Virat
videos.overview: Ishika insists on Jayesh's divorce. Amruta tries to get Virat's signature and ends up joining the party. Shekar tells Virat that Amruta is his banker.

videos.title: Virat's mother lashes out at Amruta
videos.overview: Amruta tells Harsh, her thoughts on dowry and she is overheard by Virat's mother. She abuses Amu and breaks her laptop. Ishika comes to Amruta's building

videos.title: Amruta's party upsets Babita
videos.overview: Bhavani and Jayesh's anniversary celebration begins. Meanwhile, the Ahujas come to their new apartment and are shocked to see the crowd gathered on their private terrace.

videos.title: Jayesh announces he wants a divorce
videos.overview:
Jayesh announces he wants a divorce

Babita calls the police but Virat handles the matter. Jayesh declares he wants a divorce from Bhavani and that he loves Ishika. Amu and Harsh are devastated.

videos.title: Jayesh ousts Bhavani from the house
videos.overview: Ishika comes to Jayesh's house and Jayesh asks Bhavani to leave. Babita tells Virat to demand compensation from Amu for the damage to their property.

videos.title: Amu faces trouble
videos.overview: Amu promises Virat she will compensate for the loss of his roof. She stays in a hotel, Virat coincidentally reaches there and tricks her.

videos.title: Babita gets Amu fired
videos.overview: Amu tries to talk sense with Jayesh but he believes Ishika and throws Amu out. Later Babita gets Amu in trouble with her manager. Bhavani reaches the apartment.

videos.title: Amu removes her dad's name from her's
videos.overview: Bhavani requests Jayesh to maintain a ruse until Amu is married. A visiting guru makes a prediction about Virat's married life.

videos.title: Amu asks Virat for her job back
videos.overview: Guruji advices Virat to move on from his past. Meanwhile, Harsh starts fighting with Babita. Amu empowers a broken Bhavani with her words and later tries to get her job back.

videos.title: Amruta gets her job back
videos.overview: Amu threatens Virat and he agrees to give her, her job back on a condition. Babita manipulates the building secretary and Amu receives a work call at night.

videos.title: Babita's condition to all
videos.overview: Virat harasses Amu into quitting but she remains strong. Meanwhile Babita puts forth a condition to the association that makes it hard for Amu and her family to stay there. Gautam 's mother finds the truth.

videos.title: Amruta is accused of theft
videos.overview: Gautam's mother breaks the alliance. Virat asks Amu to join him in his shopping task and Amu gets in trouble with Babita.

videos.title: Bhavani comes to Amu's rescue
videos.overview: Bhavani tries to get Jayesh's help but Ishika intervenes. Virat agrees to help Amu if she quits her job. Bhavani arrives at the police station.

videos.title: Amu takes money from Virat
videos.overview: Amruta demands a monetary compensation of 25lakh rupees from Virat for the false accusations. Rajeev decides to ruin her reputation.

videos.title: Rajeev conspires to defame Amu
videos.overview: Rajeev gives Amu a spiked drink in efforts to defame her. Virat intervenes and tries to resolve the situation before it gets out of hand.

videos.title: Virat hides Amu fron his family
videos.overview: Virat tries to distract his family while he gets Amu out of the house. Amruta is astonished to find herself in Virat's room in the morning.

videos.title: Babita is upset with Virat
videos.overview: Rajeev tries to foil Virat's plan of getting Amruta out of the house without anyone noticing. Babita is upset after finding out the truth and Virat finds out why Amruta took such a huge amount from him.

videos.title: Amruta comes to Nimmi's engagement
videos.overview: Virat calls Amu to his house for Nimrit's roka and Anjali gives her a task. Amu's health worsens and Virat tends to her.

videos.title: Virat and Amruta perform Nimmi's Roka rasm
videos.overview: The Ahujas introduce Amu as Bebe's nurse to the Sodhis. Jahan advices Bhavani on Amu's broken alliance. Virat and Amu accidentally perform Nimrit's Kudmayi

videos.title: Rajeev questions Amruta's character
videos.overview: Harsh finds out about Jayesh's plan to divorce Bhavani. Amruta slaps Rajeev and gets in trouble herself when he twists the events that occurred and frames her.

videos.title: Nimrit and Rajeev's engagement is broken
videos.overview: Rajeev's parents are furious and break the alliance. Babita's health fails and Amu arranges for medical help. Nimrit resorts to drastic measures.

videos.title: Jayesh hands divorce papers to Bhavani
videos.overview: Amu and Harsh are devastated but Bhavani makes up her mind when she is handed divorce papers by Jayesh. Virat smoothes things over with the Shekhawats.

videos.title: Amruta apologises to Rajeev
videos.overview: Bhavani's health worsens and she is rushed to the hospital. Amruta has to face humiliation for the sake of her family and apologises to Rajeev.

videos.title: Nimrit's plan to humiliate Amruta
videos.overview: Nimrit plans to take revenge on Amruta and asks Virat for an unique wedding gift. Amruta and Virat share a moment where she questions him on his Outlook towards women

videos.title: Amruta challenges Rajeev
videos.overview: Amruta is tasked with welcoming Rajeev's parents. Later, a sweet moment for the Chitnis family is ruined by court summons.

videos.title: Amruta asks Jayesh for the unthinkable
videos.overview: Amruta prays for a solution in quiet. Jayesh insults Bhavani in Judge's chambers and Amruta retaliates and demands monetary compensation for her mother's sacrifices.

videos.title: Virat tries to teach Amruta a lesson
videos.overview: The Ahuja family practices dance for the upcoming event while Bhavani expresses her anger towards Amruta. Ishika tries to manipulate Virat against Amruta.

videos.title: Virat saves Amruta from being humiliated
videos.overview: Babita is upset when she sees Amruta dancing with Virat. Rajeev tries to humiliate Amruta at the party but Virat intervenes and saves her.

videos.title: Amruta finds out Rajeev's reality
videos.overview: Virat gifts Nimi an expensive vintage car. Amruta sees Virat helping Briju and contemplates. Later Amruta walks in on Rajiv's reality and is shocked.

videos.title: Will Ahujas believe Amruta?
videos.overview: Amruta takes advice from Bhavani and tells her about Rajiv. She later confides in Nimrit. Virat gets angry and slaps Rajiv.

videos.title: Rajeev challenges Amruta
videos.overview: Babita lashes out at Amruta for misleading them. Dildar takes Amruta's side and advices Virat.

videos.title: Gautam's marriage is fixed with Amu
videos.overview: Amruta bumps into Virat at the restaurant. Gautam convinces his mother about Amruta and they arrive at Jahan's house.

videos.title: Amruta's opinion angers Babita
videos.overview: Jayesh tries to take Bhavani's jewellery away from her and Amu refuses to allow that. Amruta talks to Dildar about a business deal and Babita threatens her for the same.

videos.title: Amruta's plan to get Rajeev's truth in the open
videos.overview: Amruta asks Virat a chance to look at the contract while Babita persuades Dildar to sign it. Amruta has a plan to make Rajiv speak the truth.

videos.title: Amruta tries to give truth serum to Rajeev
videos.overview: The Ahujas celebrate Nimrit and Rajiv as Babita and Dildar grow emotional. Amruta tries her best to spike Rajiv's drink with truth serum.

videos.title: Will Amruta learn of Virat's secret
videos.overview: Deepika consumes a drink containing truth serum and tries to tell Amruta something about Virat. Ishika and Rajiv team up and try to bring down Amruta. Later, Jayesh threatens Bhavani.

videos.title: Amruta foils Ishika's plan
videos.overview: Rajiv and Nimrit exchange rings while Amruta ruins Ishika's plans. Later Amruta and Shekar discuss Ishika's plan.

videos.title: Amruta's plan to stop the wedding
videos.overview: Rajiv creates a situation that alarms Amruta and she decides to bring Rajiv's truth out in the open with Jahan Kaur's help. Unaware, Virat tasks her with something important.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Rajiv catches Amruta spying on him despite Jahan Kaur's best efforts. Babita and Dildar share concerns.

videos.title: Ishika locks Amruta up
videos.overview: Ishika deletes the video and locks Amruta in the utility closet. Bhavani agrees to Jayesh's conditions but sets some of her own. Meanwhile, Virat feels restless and confused.

videos.title: Amruta exposes Rajeev
videos.overview: Virat realises Amruta is locked up and helps her out. Amruta reveals Rajiv's truth to the Ahujas and Nimrit makes a decision.

videos.title: Nimrit marries Rajeev
videos.overview: Nimrit marries Rajiv despite everyone's objections. Virat finds out about the business deal and tears the agreement. Later, Amruta finds out the truth about Virat.

videos.title: Virat's condition to Rajeev
videos.overview: Bebe tells Amruta she cannot reveal the truth about Virat to anyone. Virat only agrees to support the marriage if Rajiv agrees to his unconventional conditions.

videos.title: Virat performs Rajeev's grihapravesh
videos.overview: Amruta, Bhavani and Harsh share an emotional moment. Virat performs Rajiv's Griha Pravesh and Amruta offers Virat a way to vent his feelings and feel good.

videos.title: Dildar performs Rajeev's Muh Dikhai ritual
videos.overview: Virat and Nimrit make up, Gautam takes Amruta on a date and they bump into familiar faces. Later, Dildar performs Rajiv's Muh Dikhaai and the latter feels humiliation.

videos.title: Bhavani leaves home
videos.overview: Amruta returns from the cafe and tells everyone what happened. Bhavani sneaks out in the morning leaving her children and home behind to fulfill the condition laid down by Jayesh.

videos.title: Nimrit asks Babita for money
videos.overview: Rajiv manipulates Nimrit into asking Babita for a share of the Ahuja money. Dildar talks to Babita about Virat's marriage and a frantic Amruta looks for Bhavani.

videos.title: Amruta brings Bhavani home
videos.overview: Virat helps Amruta in finding Bhavani and saves her from an accident. Later, Amruta confronts Jayesh.

videos.title: Nimrit lies to Virat
videos.overview: Amruta angrily tears up the divorce papers. Jahan suggests Amu and family go away for a few days.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari bumps into Babita
videos.overview: Nimrit tries to threaten Amruta into transferring money into her account. Bhavani worries about Dnyaneshwari finding out the truth about Jayesh and Ishika. Dnyaneshwari and Babita get off on the wrong foot.

videos.title: The family hides the truth from Dnyaneshwari
videos.overview: Aaji argues with Virat while Bhavani informs Jayesh of his mother's arrival. Dnyaneshwari drops a shocking information.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari opposes babita's decision
videos.overview: Dnyaneshwari plans for Amruta's engagement after Sankranti. Babita suggests they celebrate Lohri instead and Dnyaneshwari opposes.

videos.title: Amruta and Virat have to organise the event
videos.overview: Amruta resolves the dispute and later shares a moment with Virat over their event responsibilities. Dnyaneshwari questions Jayesh on seeing him with Ishika

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari tests Gautam
videos.overview: Gautam tells his mother the reason behind his alliance with Amruta. Virat and Amu misunderstand each other and Dnyaneshwari tries to test Gautam to see if he's deserving of Amu.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari finalizes Amruta's alliance
videos.overview: Amruta tells her mom to stop lying to Dnyaneshwari and tell her the truth about Ishika. Babita gives Ishika advice and Virat tries to foil their plan.

videos.title: Amruta threatens Ishika
videos.overview: Virat stops Ishika from meeting Dnyaneshwari and Amruta threatens her. Nimrit assures Rajiv she will arrange for money before Lohri. Amruta is grateful to Virat for his help.

videos.title: Rajiv sets Nimmi's dupatta on fire
videos.overview: Amruta saves Nimrit from a fire but gets into trouble with Babita. Virat apologises to Amruta on his mother's behalf and gives her, her job back.

videos.title: The priest matches Amruta and Virat's horoscope
videos.overview: Amruta challenges Virat while Babita plans Virat and Sanjana's Roka. The horoscopes get mixed up and the priest matches Amruta's kundali with Virat's.

videos.title: The Ahujas celebrate Lohri
videos.overview: Archana has an unusual demand before Amruta and Gautam's marriage. Amruta and Bhavani have some fun at the Lohri celebrations.

videos.title: Virat and Amruta celebrate Lohri together
videos.overview: Virat performs Lohri pooja with Amruta. Ishika tries to embarrass Amruta but Virat saves her and Babita lashes out at Amruta.

videos.title: Babita apologises to Amruta
videos.overview: Jayesh blames Bhavani for the argument between Babita and Dnyaneshwari. Later Virat pacifies Babita and explains why she was wrong and Babita apologises to Amruta.

videos.title: Virat is displeased with babita's decision
videos.overview: Babita announces Virat and Sanjana's engagement. Rajiv and Tara forge Virat's signature on his chequebook and Ishika discovers Virat's secret.

videos.title: Amruta and Virat share in each other's grief
videos.overview: Amruta and Virat bond over their similar experiences and Ishika overheard the conversation. Jahan and aaji plan to bring Gautam and Amu closer. Virat tries to placate an angry Babita.

videos.title: Babita forbids her family from celebrating Makar Sankranti
videos.overview: Babita informs her family that noone will be attending the society functions. Tara and Rajiv meanwhile, withdraw money from Virat's account. Amruta tries to trick Virat into attending the society event.

videos.title: Virat celebrates Makar Sankranti with Amu
videos.overview: Virat and Dildar sneak away to celebrate Makar Sankranti without Babita's knowledge. While Virat and Amu are busy with a game, Dnyaneshwari learns of Virat's truth.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari demands a promise
videos.overview: Dnyaneshwari informs Amruta of her decision and demands a promise from her. Babita arrives at the scene and Tara, Rajiv plot against Amruta.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari exposes Virat
videos.overview: Babita and Bhavani participate in a dance off. Later on seeing Amruta and Virat dance together, Babita questions the former's character and Dnyaneshwari exposes Virat's secret in front of the society people.

videos.title: Virat feels deceived by Amruta
videos.overview: Hurt by aaji's words, Virat returns home. Amruta tries to explain herself to Virat. Later, the Chitnis family plan for Amu's engagement.

videos.title: Babita's revenge on Amruta
videos.overview: Virat is sad on recalling Priyanka's betrayal. Jayesh apologises to Babita but she plans to insult Amruta anyway. Amruta is broken over Virat's anger.

videos.title: People question Virat's character
videos.overview: During a meeting, people question Virat over his divorce and Babita confronts them. An intoxicated Virat goes to the market and argues with aaji.

videos.title: Virat comes to Amu's engagement
videos.overview: Jahan locks Ishika in her house. Babita recalls her scheme. Later, Virat crashes Amruta's engagement with a plan.

videos.title: Virat tells Dnyaneshwari the truth about Jayesh and Ishika
videos.overview: Virat tells aaji that Jayesh has left Bhavani for another woman and will be divorcing her soon. Later, he gives proof.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari is shocked
videos.overview: Jayesh helps Ishika get out of the house and aaji is shocked to see her. Furthermore, aaji learns that Bhavani was thrown out of the house. Babita is happy with her son's behaviour

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari suffers a heart attack
videos.overview: Gautam's family breaks ties once again. Rajiv and Tara withdraw more money from Virat's account. Babita threatens to destroy Amruta's family.

videos.title: Amruta Harsh take aaji to the hospital
videos.overview: Virat parties with his friends and shares his grief with his father. Amruta tells Harsh not to let Jayesh meet aaji at the hospital.

videos.title: Amruta slaps Virat
videos.overview: Virat misbehaved again in public with Amu and she slaps him. Virat meanwhile decides to teach her a lesson. Dnyaneshwari regains consciousness.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari talks to Jayesh
videos.overview: Dnyaneshwari informs everyone she wants to talk to Jayesh alone. Shekar advices Virat. Bhavani requests aaji to hear her side of the story.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari supports Bhavani
videos.overview: Bhavani expresses her sorrow to Dnyaneshwari. Later, Dnyaneshwari stands by Bhavani and asks Jayesh to leave. Virat tries to uplift his family's mood.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari's wish
videos.overview: Virat is upset when Amruta breaks the windshield of his car. Ishika makes a video of Amu. Later, the Ahujas plan a surprise for Virat.

videos.title: Virat's video goes viral
videos.overview: Virat gives interviews to journalists after being awarded "Businessman of the Year" award. The video of Amruta slapping Virat goes viral and Rajiv brings it to Virat's notice. Amruta's family attend a matchmaking event.

videos.title: Virat ruins the event for Amu
videos.overview: Amruta finds someone who piques her interest during the event but Virat arrives there to ruin Amruta's moment.

videos.title: Amruta is devastated by Virat's words
videos.overview: Virat embarrasses Amruta in front of everyone and her suitor walks away. Jayesh transfers the house to Ishika. Later, Amruta challenges Virat and says she won't be defeated.

videos.title: Amruta quits her job
videos.overview: The family improves Virat's mood while Rajiv provoked Nimrit. Amruta breaks down and later quits her job with the Ahujas.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari feels guilty
videos.overview: Dnyaneshwari realises all this is her fault and misleads Harsh. Jayesh tries unsuccessfully to appease an upset Dnyaneshwari. Meanwhile, Virat gets Amruta blacklisted.

videos.title: Amruta gets a job in Delhi
videos.overview: Bhavani's condition degrades without medication. Amruta finds a new job in Delhi and Virat tries to get her fired. Amruta finds out she has a secret benefactor.

videos.title: Virat finds out about the robbery
videos.overview: Amruta tells Bhavani about her job offer. Virat prepares to visit London with his family but is shocked to learn that 10 crores have been transferred from his account.

videos.title: Virat gets Amu arrested
videos.overview: The Ahujas learn that Amruta has withdrawn the money from Virat's account. Virat calls the police and has her arrested. Jayesh refuses to help Amruta.

videos.title: An innocent Amruta gets jailed
videos.overview: Rajiv happily informs Tara about Amu's arrest. Amruta tries to hide the same from Bhavani. Virat pressures Amruta to admit she stole the money but she remains unmoved.

videos.title: Amruta's court hearing begins
videos.overview: Jahan gets Amruta a lawyer. Meanwhile, Dnyaneshwari feels uneasy and asks Bhavani to go back to the city. Amruta's hearing begins and Virat once again tries to get Amruta to admit to the crime.

videos.title: Amruta requests bail
videos.overview: Jayesh forces Amruta to apologise to Virat but Bhavani comes to the court and supports Amruta. Later Amu requests for bail to prove her innocence.

videos.title: Ishika plots against the Chitnis family
videos.overview: Jahan arranged money for Amruta's bail. Rajiv and Tara plot to harm Amruta and Ishika conspires to get Amruta and her mother ousted from the society.

videos.title: Virat stops Amruta's bail
videos.overview: Virat arrives at the police station with a stay order on Amruta's bail and upsets a senior officer.

videos.title: Virat is imprisoned
videos.overview: The senior officer jails Virat for offending him. Jayesh raises a hand on Bhavani. Later Harsh comes to bail Virat out of jail.

videos.title: Virat gets bail
videos.overview: Virat arrives home as the Ahujas plan on celebrating Nimi and Rajiv's one month anniversary. Tara comes to the station in disguise and tries to harm Amruta.

videos.title: Amruta's condition deteriorates
videos.overview: Amruta has a serious allergic reaction to the peanuts just as Virat arrives back at the police station. He is shocked to see Amruta in that state and tries to help her.

videos.title: Bhavani accuses the Ahujas
videos.overview: Amruta's family learns about her situation and Bhavani threatens the Ahujas. On the way, Amruta faints and Virat struggles to bring Amruta back.

videos.title: Virat saves Amu's life
videos.overview: Virat takes Amruta to the hospital and she gets the treatment she needs. Ishika plans to evict Amruta's family with Suman's help. Amruta tells her family that Virat saved her.

videos.title: Amu is released on medical grounds
videos.overview: Suman tricks Jahan into signing papers. Amruta is back home on bail. Shekar suspects Rajiv's hand in all this and Virat foils Amruta's plan of gathering evidence.

videos.title: Amruta is suspicious of Rajiv
videos.overview: Virat comes to meet Amruta, but she pretends to be ill. She sneaks out of the house and visits a car showroom with Kalyani and sees Tara there.

videos.title: Amruta gets Tara arrested
videos.overview: Tara is scared to see Virat coming to the car showroom and leaves. Amruta is sure of Tara and Rajiv are culprits. Later, she chases Tara with the help of a stranger and gets her arrested.

videos.title: Virat asks Rajiv for the truth
videos.overview: Virat is shocked to see who helped Amruta. Shekar tells Virat that Tara named Rajiv as a co-conspirator in her statement to the police. Later, Virat confronts Rajiv.

videos.title: Abhiraj meets the Ahujas
videos.overview: Dildar apologises to Amruta on behalf of his family. Amruta's family is impressed by Abhiraj. Abhiraj meets the Ahujas. Jahan receives a legal notice.

videos.title: Amruta's family becomes homeless
videos.overview: Ishika's men threaten Jahan. Virat finds out Amruta and her family have become homeless. Meanwhile, Babita rejoices on hearing the news. Amruta meets with an official for help.

videos.title: Amruta accuses Virat of rendering her homeless
videos.overview: Amruta accuses Virat of scheming against her and her family. Virat asks Shekar to get Amruta a new home. The money lender locks Jahan's house and Amruta comes up with a plan.

videos.title: Amruta occupies the terrace of Virat's house
videos.overview: Amruta comes to live on Virat's terrace with her family which angers the Ahujas. Virat calls the police to get them ousted. When Abhiraj tries to interfere, Virat silences him.

videos.title: Amruta blames the Ahujas
videos.overview: The police handcuff Amruta. However, Amruta proves that she has rights to be on the terrace as much as the Ahujas. Later she handcuffs Virat and throws the key away.

videos.title: Abhiraj's plan against Virat
videos.overview: Nimrit and Deepika tell Abhiraj about Amruta, and he hatches a plan against Virat. Meanwhile, Amruta asks Virat to return Jahan, her home. Jahan overheard Virat telling Shekar about his plan.

videos.title: Power outrage troubles Amruta's family
videos.overview: Amruta accuses Virat of deliberately harassing her causing a power outage. Later, Amruta makes a promise to Jahan. The next day, Amruta and family perform puja which bothers the Ahujas.

videos.title: A deadly plot against Amruta
videos.overview: Abhiraj takes Amruta and Virat's photo. Virat asks Shekar to find the person who usurped Jahan's house. Babita and Ishika hatch a deadly plot against Amruta and her family, but Babita falls for it.

videos.title: Ishika executes her ploy
videos.overview: Amruta tends to Virat's wounds and Abhiraj secretly records them. Ishika and Babita hatch a new ploy against Amruta. Women from the NGO come to Ahuja house.

videos.title: Virat saves Amruta and Bhavani's life
videos.overview: Babita opposes Ishika's plan. The cylinder explodes as soon as Amruta and Bhavani light a match. However, Virat saves them. Dildar is suspicious of Babita and Ishika of having a hand in this.

videos.title: Abhiraj instigates Amruta against Virat
videos.overview: Virat helps Bhavani in cleaning the kitchen. Abhiraj instigates Amruta implying that Virat cut the cylinder tube. Later, Virat suspects Ishika's hand in all this.

videos.title: The police warn the Ahujas
videos.overview: At Amruta's complaint, the police warn the Ahujas. Virat claims his innocence. Later, Abhiraj's mom comes to Ahuja house and argues with Bhavani.

videos.title: Virat ruins Amruta's interview
videos.overview: Abhiraj's mother talks to Babita about ousting Amruta's family from the terrace. Amruta tries to give a job interview but a drunk Virat ruins it for her.

videos.title: Abhiraj and Kavi's plan
videos.overview: Amruta lies to Bhavani that she rejected the job. Abhiraj and Kavi plan to use Amruta to defeat Virat. The Ahujas go to a party to celebrate a buisness deal.

videos.title: Amruta insults Virat at the party
videos.overview: Amruta decides to teach Virat a lesson and arrives at the party pretending to be drunk. Dildar is upset with Amruta's behaviour and the deal falls through.

videos.title: Amruta apologises to Dildar
videos.overview: Amruta feels terrible for upsetting Dildar and apologised to him. Bhavani loses get temper at Amu after seeing the video of her at the party.

videos.title: Amruta convinces the Singhanias to take the deal
videos.overview: Ishika and Jayesh meet Babita for work. Amruta apologises to Singhania and asks him to give the Ahujas a chance to prove themselves.

videos.title: Virat invites Amruta to the Holi party
videos.overview: At Babita's insistence, Virat invites Amruta to the holika dhahan. Abhiraj flirts with Amruta and that upsets Virat. Amruta's family is shocked to see Jayesh at the party with Ishika.

videos.title: Babita conducts Jayesh and Ishika's roka
videos.overview: Babita's announcement of Jayesh and Ishika's Roka at the party shocks everyone. Later, Babita taunts Bhavani and asks her to give Ishika shagun. Amruta stands up for her mother.

videos.title: Virat and Bhavani share their pain
videos.overview: Bhavani leaves the party and her family looks for her. Abhiraj and Kavi make it seem as if this is Virat's fault. Meanwhile Virat and Bhavani bond over their respective failed marriages.

videos.title: Abhiraj overhears Amruta
videos.overview: Virat apologises to Bhavani and brings her to Amruta. Later, Amruta devises a plan to stop Jayesh and Ishika's engagement which Abhiraj overhears and decides to ruin.

videos.title: Amruta and bhavani attend the engagement
videos.overview: Bhavani thanks Amruta and Jahaan for being her support system. Amruta tells Virat she wants to start fresh. Later, Amruta attends Jayesh and Ishika's engagement with Jahan, Bhavani and a lawyer.

videos.title: Amruta's plan fails
videos.overview: Amruta's plan to stop the engagement is foiled by Ishika and Abhiraj. Virat makes Bhavani smile and everyone celebrates Holi. Abhiraj and Kavi meanwhile, plan to get Amruta and Virat high on bhang.

videos.title: Virat and Amu are intoxicated
videos.overview: Virat and Amruta compete in a pani puri eating contest. Abhiraj adds bhang to it and Virat and Amruta get high. Kavita schemes and sends them to Virat's room.

videos.title: Abhiraj's plan to malign Virat
videos.overview: Abhiraj makes a video of Amruta and Virat to malign Virat. Later, Abhiraj tries to administer a sedative to Amruta.

videos.title: Bhavani and Babita get into a fight
videos.overview: Virat opens up to Amruta in his inebriated state. Bhavani and Babita exchange words when Babita tries to taunt Bhavani again.

videos.title: Harsh and Jahan misunderstand Virat
videos.overview: Harsh and Jahan accuse Virat of trying to take advantage of Amruta and Kavita adds fuel to the fire. Later, Harsh calls the police but Amruta regains consciousness and sends them away.

videos.title: Ishika and Abhiraj trap Virat
videos.overview: Amruta says Virat did not take advantage of her. Ishika and Abhiraj try to trap Virat saying he drugged Amruta and himself. Meanwhile Babita turns the tables and accuses Amruta.

videos.title: Amruta gets proof of Virat's innocence
videos.overview: Virat suspects that Abhiraj is behind the whole conspiracy while Amruta suspects Ishika. Babita accuses Amruta of causing tension between the brothers.

videos.title: Virat decides to send Amruta away
videos.overview: Amruta tells Virat that he cannot accuse Abhiraj without proof. Virat decides to get Amruta a job out of Mumbai to keep her safe. Ishika and Babita come to the terrace to celebrate Gudi Padwa.

videos.title: Abhiraj helps Ishika
videos.overview: Amruta decides to leave the city to save Bhavani and Virat from Ishika. Virat along with Sheky find out who is behind the plot to steal Jahan's house but Abhiraj intervenes and saves Ishika from being caught.

videos.title: Babita insults Amruta
videos.overview: Amruta scolds Virat for fighting with Babita. Babita calls Bhavani an abandoned woman and stops her from celebrating Gudi Padwa. Later, the women in society support Bhavani.

videos.title: Babita accuses Amruta
videos.overview: Kavita and Abhiraj try to frame Babita through Harsh. Amruta however does not believe this and tells Virat the same. Babita blames Amruta for creating a rift between her and Virat.

videos.title: Amruta worries about bhavani
videos.overview: Amruta and Bhavani have a heartfelt conversation and Amruta is upset seeing Bhavani lose courage. Kavita and Abhiraj continue to plan Virat's downfall.

videos.title: Bhavani comes to Ishika's mehendi
videos.overview: Virat takes Bhavani to Ishika's mehendi and dances with the Chitnis women. Bhavani performs rituals for Ishika and the society women applaud Bhavani for her courage to move on.

videos.title: Amruta and Virat abduct an officer
videos.overview: Shekar gives some information to Virat and Amruta that make them leave the mehendi function. Ishika is worried Virat and Amruta might to be close to uncovering the truth about her.

videos.title: Virat and Amruta follow a lead
videos.overview: Virat and Amruta look for Suman based on the the officer's lead. Babita plans to humiliate Bhavani at the mehendi. Later, Suman's maid tells Virat and Amruta that Suman has left for her village.

videos.title: Virat supports Bhavani
videos.overview: Abhiraj gives Suman money to leave the city. When Bhavani is mocked for being a divorcee, Virat joins her and shoes his support. Bebe talks to Babita.

videos.title: Amruta and Virat's promise
videos.overview: Amruta and Virat promise to protect each other. Bhavani tells Amruta that she wants a suitor for her like Virat. Later, Amruta sees Ishika waiting for Abhiraj

videos.title: Amruta is happy about her job
videos.overview: Kavita executes a ploy to save Ishika and Abhiraj from Amruta. Amruta tells Bhavani about her Bangalore job. Babita hatches a new ploy. Shekar gets CCTV footage of Suman.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari makes Bhavani take off her mangalsutra
videos.overview: Virat suspects that Abhiraj cautioned Suman. The women force Bhavani to participate in Ishika and Jayesh's Haldi. Dnyaneshwari gets Bhavani to take off her mangalsutra and gifts her a chain to wear instead.

videos.title: Virat and Amu's plan goes well
videos.overview: Dnyaneshwari hears Abhiraj's sweet tone and scolds him. Amruta and Virat's plan is successful and Ishika is scared. Babita asks Virat to find a companion. Jayesh argues with Amu.

videos.title: Suman comes to see Ishika
videos.overview: Virat and Amruta collect evidence by snatching Abhiraj's phone. Dnyaneshwari and Jahaan talk to Amruta about her future groom. Suman comes to see Ishika. And Amruta notices her.

videos.title: Ishika escapes from Amruta
videos.overview: Ishika tries to meet Suman but notices Amruta waiting for her. Later, Dnyaneshwari finds an earring which she had gifted to Bhavani.

videos.title: Amruta slaps Ishika
videos.overview: Jayesh and Ishika's wedding rituals begin. After the wedding, Amruta shows Bhavani's missing earring and exposes Ishika. Amruta slaps Ishika when she tries to abuse Bhavani.

videos.title: Ishika is exposed
videos.overview: Amruta exposes Ishika. Bhavani demands Jahan's house back in exchange of dropping the police complaint on Ishika. Babita apologises to Bhavani.

videos.title: Jayesh and Ishika get into a fight
videos.overview: Jayesh and Ishika threaten each other after a fight. Jahan is happy with hope of getting her home back. Virat and Amruta spend time together. Later, Abhiraj hatches another plan.

videos.title: Abhiraj's goons attack Virat and Amruta
videos.overview: Virat gifts a new house to Amruta and Bhavani. Abhiraj's goons attack Virat and Amruta. Amruta decides to help Virat and sends Bhavani home.

videos.title: Virat and Amruta escape the goons
videos.overview: A trucker brings an unconscious Bhavani home. Virat hides from Abhiraj's goons with Amruta. Later, she tries to treat Virat's injured hand.

videos.title: Amruta and Virat look after each other
videos.overview: Amruta and Virat treat each other's injuries and the police track them down. Amruta finds Priyanka's ring in Virat's wallet. While Bhavani reaches home, Abhiraj looks for Virat and Amu.

videos.title: Virat brings Amruta home
videos.overview: Babita is upset to learn that Virat has gifted a house to Amruta. Virat comes home with an unconscious Amruta. The family is shocked to see Virat and Amruta's photos on media.

videos.title: Amruta gives a shocking statement
videos.overview: Bhavani worries when Amruta does not regain consciousness. Virat is arrested prematurely and Ishika tries to malign him in front of NGO women. Later, Amruta gives a shocking statement to the police.

videos.title: Dnyaneshwari locks Amruta up
videos.overview: Amruta tells the magistrate that Virat promised to marry her and everything happened between them was consensual. The Chitnis family returns to Jahan's house.

videos.title: Ishika attempts to throw Bhavani out
videos.overview: Bebe and Dnyaneshwari keep Virat and Amruta away from each other. Amruta explains their situation to Bhavani. Meanwhile Ishika tries to get Amruta and Bhavani ousted from the society, again.

videos.title: Amruta tries to meet Virat
videos.overview: The women in the society refuse to support Ishika. Amruta asks Shekar to help her meet Virat. Dnyaneshwari suspects Amruta and plans to ruin her meeting.

videos.title: Virat leaves for London
videos.overview: Under pressure from his family, Virat leaves for London. Amruta tries to meet Virat and heads to the airport after listening to his voice note.

videos.title: Amruta and Virat decide to marry
videos.overview: On the way to the airport, Virat helps a couple in love. Amruta meets him there and offers a solution to their predicament. Later, Babita is upset to learn Amruta and Virat's decision.

videos.title: Virat proposes to Amruta
videos.overview: Virat gets down on one knee and asks Amruta's hand in marriage in front of their families. Bhavani worries about Amruta's prenup with Virat. Later Amruta makes sweets for their families and Virat teases her.

videos.title: Amruta's challenge to Ishika
videos.overview: On mother's day, Amruta arrives to feed laddu to Babita but gets insulted. Amruta challenges Ishika that Bhavani will earn money within 12 hours. Virat transfers Abhiraj's phone data to his phone

videos.title: Bhavani prepares the food
videos.overview: Amruta transfers Ishika's phone data to her phone. Babita calls Suresh with a task. Bhavani begins to prepare food. Later Virat lends a helping hand.

videos.title: Virat is unaware of Babita's involvement
videos.overview: Virat tries to catch the person who leaked his and Amruta's photos, but is unaware that Babita has gotten Suresh to do all this. Babita asks Suresh to stay hidden. Later, Virat finds a clue.

videos.title: Virat wears a Maharashtrian cap
videos.overview: The decoration of the house for Virat and Amruta's engagement angers Babita. Amruta's decision upsets Harsh. Amruta's conscience questions her about the decision.

videos.title: Amruta and Virat are engaged
videos.overview: Jayesh attends Virat and Amruta's engagement to bless them. Dildar gives an emotional speech and welcomed Amruta to the family. Later, Amruta puts a ring on Virat and Babita schemes to disrupt the celebration.

videos.title: Virat pretends to fight with Amu
videos.overview: Babita keeps the phone used to leak the photos in Amruta's bag and Virat pretends to fight with Amruta over the same. Later, he sends the phone to a forensic lab for testing but Babita finds out.

videos.title: Virat lies to Babita
videos.overview: Babita gets the forensic test report changed. When Amruta and Babita argue, Virat intervenes and lies on Amruta's behalf. Later, Amruta and Virat's mehendi rituals begin.

videos.title: Babita tries to ruin the mehendi function
videos.overview: Virat and Amruta dance during their Mehendi. Babita tricks to separate Virat and Amruta. Soon, Virat and Amruta have a disagreement and Babita learns of their prenup.

videos.title: Babita's new plan
videos.overview: Bhavani asks Harsh to support Amruta. Virat puts a toe ring on Amruta's toe. During Virat and Amruta's Seemant Puja, Babita spikes Bhavani's drink.

videos.title: Virat and Amruta argue
videos.overview: Virat and Amruta have another disagreement after they try to handle an intoxicated Bhavani.

videos.title: Virat and Amruta's emotional dance
videos.overview: Bhavani threatens to expose Virat and Amruta's pretence and asks them to agree to a truce. Abhiraj and Kavita discuss a new plan while Amruta and Virat share an emotional dance.

videos.title: Virat and Amruta catch Suresh
videos.overview: Ishika and Jayesh insult Bhavani during Virat and Amruta's sangeet which angers Bhavani. Virat and Amruta catch Suresh and question him. Babita worries when she fails to contact Suresh.

videos.title: Suresh is arrested
videos.overview: Suresh attacks Virat with a knife but gets arrested. The news of Suresh's arrest troubles Babita and she decides to bail him out soon. Abhiraj and Kavita learn the truth about Babita.

videos.title: Abhiraj's plan to attack Bhavani
videos.overview: Babita tries to flee after bailing Suresh out of jail but Amruta sees her ring. Abhiraj comes and stops Amruta from uncovering Babita's identity. Later Babita gives Kavita her ring and Abhiraj makes a plan to attack Bhavani.

videos.title: Amruta and Virat feel affectionate towards each other
videos.overview: Amruta tells Virat that she can never fall for him. Someone records Amruta, Jahan and Bhavani talking. Ishika is jealous of Amruta's gift. Amruta and Virat sense a connection.

videos.title: Dildar falls ill
videos.overview: Abhiraj spikes the food prepared by Bhavani and that gives Dildar food poisoning. Babita scolds Amruta and Bhavani for trying to harm Dildar. Later, Virat and Amruta enjoy their haldi ceremony.

videos.title: Amruta thinks Kavita is guilty
videos.overview: Amruta sees the ring on Kavitas finger and wonders if she is the one who leaked their photos to the media. She shares her suspicions with Virat and Virat shares his feelings about his family.

videos.title: Will Amruta uncover the truth
videos.overview: Babita finds her ring in the washroom and wears it again. Amruta writes a note to Kavita formulating a plan and Babita reads the note instead.

videos.title: Amruta sees Babita's true colors
videos.overview: Amruta is shocked to learn that Babita is the person behind everything. Babita throws money at Amruta and asks her to leave Virat's life.

videos.title: Virat learns about Babita's accident
videos.overview: Virat comes looking for Amruta and before she's able to confide in him, he gets a call from the hospital informing him of Babita's accident. Virat vows to punish whoever is responsible for the same.

videos.title: Babita tries to implicate Amruta
videos.overview: The police come to take Babita's statement and she says that Amruta pushed her in front of the truck. She later calls Amruta greedy. Virat tries to support Amruta by explaining what she was up to.

videos.title: Virat decides to find the truth
videos.overview: Babita accuses Amruta for several things which shock Virat and he decides to find the truth behind it all. Later, Abhiraj and Babita rejoice at the success of their plan.

videos.title: Virat is suspicious of Amruta
videos.overview: The attacker says Amruta paid him to abduct her and Virat. After seeing a video of Amruta collecting the money, Virat starts believing the accusations against her. Later, Amruta tries to explain herself to Shekar.

videos.title: Virat is convinced of Amu's guilt
videos.overview: A few people claim to be eyewitness to what happened between Amruta and Babita and testify that Amruta was harrassing Babita. Later, a woman shows Virat another video of Amruta painting her guilty.

videos.title: Amruta fails to prove her innocence
videos.overview: Amruta fails to prove her innocence. The police bring Suresh to the scene and he also accuses Amruta as being his boss. Later, Virat says many hurtful things to Bhavani and Amruta.

videos.title: Virat accuses Bhavani
videos.overview: Virat calls Bhavani a mastermind behind all this and asks the police to arrest her. Later, he puts forth an impossible condition to Amruta if she wants him to drop the charge against Bhavani.

videos.title: Virat and Amruta are married
videos.overview: Virat applies kumkum on Amruta's forehead. Later, he shocks the Ahujas by revealing his marriage to Amruta. Babita is shocked and Dildar is enraged.

videos.title: Amruta attempts to nullify her marriage
videos.overview: Bhavani lashes out at Jayesh for abusing Amruta. Amruta asks Virat to sign papers cancelling their marriage. Later, the Chitnis family returns to Jahan's house and Amruta breaks down.

videos.title: Court summons for Virat!
videos.overview: Amruta regrets trusting Virat. He brings Amruta home at night and locks her in the bathroom. Later, her lawyer brings a court summons for Virat.

videos.title: Virat tricks the lawyer
videos.overview: Amruta argues with Virat when Virat tries to prove that Amruta and Virat married consensually. Later, Dildar arrives at Jahan's house to talk to Amruta about accepting her reality.

videos.title: Dildar organises Amruta's Grihapravesh
videos.overview: Virat tells Babita that he wants to break Amruta's spirit while Dildar promises Amruta to help her in foiling Virat's plan. Later, Dildar organises a Grihapravesh ceremony to officially welcome Amruta into the family.

videos.title: Dildar accepts Amu as his daughter in law
videos.overview: Babita is upset at Dildar for supporting Amruta but he stays true to his promise to Amruta. Virat gifts Amruta a necklace given to him by Dildar. Bhavani is worried about Amruta's fate at the hands of the Ahujas.

videos.title: Babita's move against the Ahujas
videos.overview: Amruta locks Virat in the washroom. Babita is upset when she sees Amruta settling in and later, everyone praises Amruta for her pehli rasoi dish.

videos.title: Babita stops her pretence
videos.overview: The Ahujas find Babita trapped in the elevator and try to get Bhavani arrested for the same. Later, Juneja visits the Ahujas and expresses his desire to meet Virat's wife.

videos.title: Virat asks Amu to help him
videos.overview: Juneja asks Virat to come to Goa with his wife and seal the deal. Virat asks Amruta to accompany him and puts another condition. Abhiraj and Kavita turn their attention to Harsh while Rajiv gets in trouble with Dildar.

videos.title: Babita sees Virat and Amu together
videos.overview: Before leaving Goa, Amruta takes Virat's sign on a document. Dildar tells Babita that Virat and Amruta were made for each other despite the circumstances they married. Abhiraj makes a bold move.

videos.title: Juneja is impressed by Amu
videos.overview: Harsh is accused of cheating in an exam and Amruta saves him. The Ahujas get to Goa without Amruta. Later, Harsh helps Amruta reach Goa on time and she manages to impress the Junejas.

videos.title: Amruta tries to help a girl
videos.overview: Juneja tells Virat he is lucky to have married Amruta. Rajiv misbehaves with Nimrit again. Amruta tries to save a girl from some drunk men who try to attack Amruta instead.

videos.title: Virat saves Amruta
videos.overview: Virat rushes to Amruta's rescue when he heard her scream and thrashes the goons. He consoles Amruta and compliments her courage. Later, once the men are arrested, Virat takes care of Amruta.

videos.title: Virat sees Amruta with Priyanka
videos.overview: Dildar asks Virat to stop hurting Amruta. After the deal is finalised, Juneja talks about naming the resort after Amruta and Virat. Later, Virat is shocked to see Amruta with Priyanka

videos.title: Virat saves Priyanka
videos.overview: Amruta and Priyanka fall into a swimming pool and Virat jumps in to save Priyanka. Dildar lashes out at Rajiv after seeing Nimrit's bruises. Later, Amruta is upset with Virat.

videos.title: Virat is suspicious of Amruta's intentions
videos.overview: Priyanka tries to make Virat uncomfortable in front of Amruta. Virat accuses Amruta of calling Priyanka to Goa. Later, Amruta is stuck in a dilemma.

videos.title: Priyanka is upset
videos.overview: Virat and Amruta fall asleep next to each other while talking and Priyanka is upset her plan is not going her way. Dildar shares a good news with everyone.

videos.title: Virat's condition shocks the Ahujas
videos.overview: Amruta brings home an unconscious sick Virat and Babita scolds her for being careless. Bhavani encourages Amruta to fight for her rights and Amruta hides the Goa incident from her family.

videos.title: Amruta takes care of Virat
videos.overview: Amruta feels Priyanka's presence in Goa was not a coincidence. Harsh makes a new friend. Amruta looks after Virat the whole night and Dildar praises her in the morning.

videos.title: Isha wants to meet Harsh
videos.overview: Virat and Amruta plan a surprise party for Dildar and Babita. Shekar sees a bruise on Nimrit's cheeks and questions her. Harsh meets Isha again while Amruta gets a call from her past.

videos.title: Priyanka gatecrashes the party
videos.overview: Rajiv tells Nimrit to ask Dildar for money. Virat dances with Amruta during the anniversary celebrations. Priyanka arrives just in time to break them up.

videos.title: Priyanka's shocking news
videos.overview: Priyanka tells everyone that she is still, legally, Virat's wife. Ishika calls Amruta a homewrecker which angers Bhavani.

videos.title: Ishika's words break Amruta
videos.overview: Bhavani slaps Ishika when Ishika compares Amruta to herself. Jayesh yells at Amruta but she stands her ground. Dildar asks Amruta to go back with her mother and promises to resolve this.

videos.title: Priyanka refuses to divorce Virat
videos.overview: Virat tells Amruta that Priyanka refuses to divorce him. Babita and Priyanka have a conversation behind closed doors and later Virat tries to explain his past to Amruta.

videos.title: Amruta refuses to help Virat
videos.overview: Virat is devastated when Amruta refuses to help him. Dildar talks to Babita about his suspicions regarding Priyanka and warns her. Bhavani asks Amruta to support Virat.

videos.title: Virat meets with an accident
videos.overview: Amruta comes back to talk to Virat but he leaves in anger. Later, the family get news of his accident and they argue regarding the course of his treatment.

videos.title: Amruta decides to perform Vat Savitri puja
videos.overview: Babita regrets calling Priyanka back. Amruta learns that Virat preserved a broken piece of her glass bangle. She performs Vat Savitri puja for Virat's health but Priyanka says that is her right.

videos.title: Dildar plans to reveal Priyanka's secret
videos.overview: Everyone is happy to see the improvement in Virat's health. Dildar gives him some advice and promises to help Amruta reveal Priyanka's true reason for coming back.

videos.title: Harsh steals Bhavani's money
videos.overview: Virat realises Amruta's importance in his life. Harsh steals Bhavani's money from the cupboard and threatens the family on being caught. Virat scolds Harsh for being rude.

videos.title: Harsh is arrested
videos.overview: Amruta breaks her fast with Virat. Isha gets Harsh arrested for molesting her and Bhavani is shocked. Virat asks Priyanka to leave the house. Amruta demands the truth from Harsh.

videos.title: Amruta is suspicious of Isha
videos.overview: Amruta is suspicious of Isha when she sees her smiling at the police station. Learning about Harsh's arrest, Virat arrives to help Amruta. Ishika, along with a few society women, try to get the Chitnis family ousted again.

videos.title: Virat addresses Amruta as his wife
videos.overview: Babita supports the society women and Virat comes to stand by Amruta. Dildar scolds Babita. Later, Virat cleans Jahan's house along with Amruta and calls her his wife.

videos.title: Virat gathers information about Isha
videos.overview: Dildar is curious to see Nimrit wearing sunglasses at home. Babita gives Rajiv a check of rs. 10 lakhs. Virat tries to gather information about Isha. Later, Amruta's screams shock Virat.

videos.title: Virat shows Amu a photo
videos.overview: Amruta tells Virat about Jahan and says she will leave the society for their sake. Virat shows Amruta a photo he received on his phone and they're shocked at what they find.

videos.title: Virat and Amu's plan
videos.overview: Virat tells Amruta that he and Priyanka are divorced. Amruta and Bhavani come to stay at Virat's house. Virat and Amruta work on their plan against Priyanka.

videos.title: Isha confesses on camera
videos.overview: Amruta puts Priyanka's phone back in her room. Nimrit hides her injury from Amruta but Amruta gets suspicious. Virat and Amruta execute their plan against Priyanka and Isha.

videos.title: Isha is arrested
videos.overview: At the police station, Harsh tries to kill himself with the inspector's weapon. Amruta and Virat arrive in time to stop him. Isha is arrested after Amruta and Virat submit proof against her.

videos.title: Amruta and Virat's plan is foiled
videos.overview: Amruta and Virat fail in their efforts to prove Priyanka guilty in front of the police. Bhavani is happy to receive the letter regarding Amruta's job. Later, Priyanka tries to trick Virat.

videos.title: Bhavani takes Amruta away
videos.overview: Bhavani brings Amruta back from Virat's house. Under pressure from the society, Ishika apologises to the Chitnis women. Later, Bhavani tells Virat that Amruta will leave the country for work.

videos.title: Priyanka hatches a dangerous plan
videos.overview: Priyanka decides to avenge Amruta's slap. Babita stops Virat and Priyanka's divorce. Later Priyanka sends laddus to Jahan's house under Dildar's name.

videos.title: Amruta's condition deteriorates
videos.overview: Dildar tells Virat to apologise to Amruta. Virat visits Amruta's house but finds out that she is on an interview. Meanwhile, Amruta eats the laddus and has an allergy attack.

videos.title: Amruta is intoxicated
videos.overview: Virat arrives in time to save Amruta and takes care of her. Nimrit visits Amruta's house looking for Virat and later, Amruta is intoxicated from the medicine.

videos.title: Dildar finds out the truth
videos.overview: An intoxicated Amruta asks Virat to promise something and he does. While they share an intimate moment together, Nimrit shows Babita another bruise from being hit by Rajiv and Babita's reaction shocks her. Later Dildar overhears Babita and Priyanka.

videos.title: Priyanka hides Raja from Virat
videos.overview: Babita's actions sadden Dildar. Priyanka blackmails Raja and makes him leave the Ahuja house before Virat comes back. Babita visits Amruta's house and creates a scene.

videos.title: Amruta decides to move into the Ahuja House
videos.overview: Amruta and Dildar talk about Babita and she agrees to move in to the house to reveal the truth about Priyanka's reentry to everyone but on a condition.

videos.title: Amruta foils Priyanka's plan
videos.overview: Ishika gives Priyanka some advice on how to get Virat back in her life. However Amruta comes just in time and ruins their plan.

videos.title: Amruta shares her plans with Dildar
videos.overview: Babita tells Priyanka, she has her full support. Amruta asks Dildar to create a rift between Priyanka and Babita. Amruta learns that noone in the Ahuja house can cook and later Virat teases Amruta.

videos.title: Amruta makes breakfast
videos.overview: Amruta makes breakfast for everyone and despite her efforts, Babita tries to insult her. Later, Priyanka and Ishika overheard Bhavani talking to another woman.

videos.title: Ishika helps Priyanka win over Virat
videos.overview: Amruta performs the Mangala Gauri puja while Priyanka hosts a party inside. Amruta arrives just as Rajiv raises his hand at Nimrit.

videos.title: Virat applies sindoor and haldi on Amruta
videos.overview: Babita tells Dildar that she wants to defeat Priyanka. Virat completes the puja rasm with Amruta by applying sindoor and haldi to her. At the party, a few women ask Virat and Priyanka to kiss.

videos.title: Amruta and Dildar's attempt to spoil the party
videos.overview: Babita tries to stop Virat and Amruta's relationship going public. Later, Priyanka comes up with an idea.

videos.title: Virat foils Priyanka's plan
videos.overview: Amruta's arrival at the party makes Virat happy. Soon, the Marathi and Punjabi girls have a dance-off. Priyanka trips Amruta but Virat helps her and later announces she's his wife.

videos.title: Babita has disappeared!
videos.overview: Dildar is happy to see Babita and Priyanka fight. Later, Babita pretends to be missing and Virat is very upset. Later, Amruta finds Babita's location and tells Virat.

videos.title: Babita returns home on condition
videos.overview: In exchange for returning home, Babita asks Virat never to address Amruta as his wife. Later, Rajiv fakes an apology to Nimrit.

videos.title: Rajiv sells Nimrit
videos.overview: Virat wishes Amruta good luck for her interview. Rajiv hands Nimrit over to his clients in exchange for a contract. Later, Amruta, who has her interview in the same hotel hears Nimrit screaming.

videos.title: Amruta saves Nimrit
videos.overview: Nimrit escapes the clutches of Rajiv's clients but runs into Rajiv. As he is taking her back, Amruta intervenes and saves Nimrit.

videos.title: Virat transfers money to Amruta
videos.overview: Amruta learns of Priyanka's plan and why Nimrit was present at the hotel. Dildar asks Virat to take care of Amruta. Later, Virat sends Amu some money.

videos.title: Amruta installs a camera in Nimrit's room
videos.overview: Virat tells Amu he is fulfilling his duties as her husband. Amruta installs cameras in Nimrit's room. While everyone tries to make Nimrit's first teej special, Ishika and Priyanka comes up with another plan.

videos.title: Amruta gives Nimrit advice
videos.overview: Babita talks about gifting Rajiv and Nimrit a penthouse for their stay, which adds to Amruta's worry. Virat feels Amruta is hiding something. Later, Amruta advices Nimrit.

videos.title: Rajiv burns Nimrit's hand
videos.overview: Nimrit comes to share her grief with Dildar, but Rajiv comes there. Virat gives Amruta a rose on the occasion of Teej. While Amruta makes Goddess Parvati's idol, Rajiv pours hot tea on Nimrit's hand.

videos.title: Rajiv harrasses Nimrit
videos.overview: Amruta performs Teej puja. Rajiv beats Nimrit with a belt and misbehaves with her. Virat saves Amruta from Priyanka and Ishika's ploy. Amruta worries for Nimrit when she is not seen at the puja.

videos.title: Amruta empowers Nimrit to tell the truth
videos.overview: Amruta hits Rajiv with a golf stick, but soon everyone gathers there. She asks Nimrit to tell everyone about Virat's reality and Babita pretends to faint. Later, Dildar asks Nimrit for the truth.

videos.title: Rajiv's truth comes to the fore
videos.overview: Virat beats Rajiv after Amruta exposes him showing a camera footage. While Virat and Dildar regret being unable to take care of Nimrit, Babita says that compromises have to be made in marriage.

videos.title: The inspector refuses to arrest Rajiv
videos.overview: Dildar talks about getting Rajiv punished while Babita and Bebe wish to give him a chance to reform. The inspector refuses to arrest Rajiv without Nimrit's complaint, and everyone looks at Nimrit.

videos.title: Rajiv is arrested
videos.overview: Amruta asks Nimrit to reveal the truth to the police, while Babita asks her to send the police back. Rajiv is arrested after Nimrit shows her injuries to the police. Later, Nimrit embraces Amruta.

videos.title: Virat realises Amruta's pain
videos.overview: Amruta consoles Nimrit and takes care of her. Babita thinks of ousting Amruta from the house. Virat sees Bhavani in his dream and her words make him realise that he has wronged Amruta.

videos.title: Virat's plan to apologise to Amruta
videos.overview: Virat's family performs the 'aarti'. Later, Virat practises apologising to Amruta in person. Amruta and others bring Nimrit to a function in the society to make her feel better.

videos.title: Virat apologises to Amruta
videos.overview: On Independence Day, Virat hoists the flag with Nimrit and apologises to Amruta for his actions. Amruta and Dildar execute a new plan against Priyanka. Later, cultural events happen in the society.

videos.title: Babita suspects Priyanka
videos.overview: Babita falls prey to Amruta and Dildar's ploy and slaps Priyanka due to her suspicions. Amruta is in a fix when Virat talks about freeing her from the marriage. Later, Priyanka threatens Babita.

videos.title: Virat and Amruta come close
videos.overview: Shekhar plans to unite Virat and Amruta. Both come close, but are soon interrupted by Priyanka. Later, Priyanka tells Babita about Dildar's ploy to trap her.

videos.title: Babita learns of Dildar's ploy
videos.overview: Priyanka tells Babita that Dildar is plotting against her. Kavita and Bebe taunt Nimrit. Later, Ishika and Priyanka plot to spoil the food ordered by Bhavani.

videos.title: Harsh gives great news
videos.overview: Ishika and Priyanka fail to destroy Bhavani's order. Virat makes Nimrit a partner of more than half of the property. Later, the Chitnis family is happy with the news of Harsh becoming a doctor.

videos.title: A new conspiracy against the Chitnis family
videos.overview: The Chitnis family attends an event with the visiting card made by Virat for Bhavani. Priyanka executes a new conspiracy there. Babita texts her as Virat comes to see Babita.

videos.title: Priyanka's plan to trap Amruta
videos.overview: Virat praises the food made by Amruta. Priyanka humiliates Amruta in front of everyone at the party. Later, she hides a necklace in a purse and pretends to search for it in front of everyone.

videos.title: Amruta dances at Priyanka's behest
videos.overview: Priyanka accuses Jahaan of stealing a necklace, but Amruta tries to protect Jahaan. At Priyanka's insistence, Amruta dances in front of everyone. Babita watches Amruta's dance video.

videos.title: Ishika tries to investigate Bhavani
videos.overview: Harsh tells Virat about Amruta's humiliation, and Virat lashes out at Priyanka. Meanwhile, Ishika tries to instigate Bhavani against the Ahujas. Amruta decides to teach Priyanka a lesson.

videos.title: Amruta talks about filing a case against Priyanka
videos.overview: After Virat asks Nimrit and Anjali to oust Priyanka from the house, Priyanka misbehaves with them. Amruta stops Virat from throwing Priyanka out and asks him to file a case against her instead.

videos.title: Virat's plan to teach Priyanka a lesson
videos.overview: Priyanka and Ishika hatch a plan. Virat teases Amruta while discussing the preparations for Janmashtami celebration. He later takes Bhavani and Jahaan out for shopping and calls Priyanka there.

videos.title: Priyanka falls for Virat's trick
videos.overview: Priyanka comes to the clothes store and insults Bhavani and Jahaan. As per his plan, Virat accuses Priyanka of theft and asks her to apologise to Jahaan to save herself.

videos.title: Priyanka's dangerous ploy against Amruta
videos.overview: Priyanka apologises to Jahan. Amruta prepares for Janmashtami, and Priyanka and Ishika plan to add shards of glass in the pot. Virat expresses his wish to become Kanha, and Amruta laughs at him.

videos.title: Virat tries to become Kanha for Janmashtami
videos.overview: Virat tries to persuade Amruta to let him become Kanha. Priyanka and Ishika fill a pot with gunpowder. Babita clears Amruta's doubts. Later, Virat makes a promise to Bhavani.

videos.title: Amruta and Nimrit's performance
videos.overview: A masked person steals some papers from Nimrit's room. Amruta and Nimrit perform an act as Radha and Krishna. Priyanka heats the puja plate on the gas to burn Amruta's hand.

videos.title: Priyanka and Ishika's new conspiracy
videos.overview: Amruta's hands get burnt while moving the puja thali away. Virat tries to soothe it with ice. Later, Priyanka and Ishika execute a new conspiracy by participating in the Matki painting competition.

videos.title: Priyanka tampers with the Handi
videos.overview: Virat and Amruta dance together at the society's Dahi Handi festival. Priyanka mixes something in the pot before it is hung to a rope. Nimrit and Anjali leave Amruta and join Virat's team.

videos.title: Amruta suspects Priyanka
videos.overview: Amruta asks Anjali for help as she suspects Priyanka after seeing her breaking and throwing a pot. Virat asks Amruta to go on a date with him if he wins and soon the Dahi Handi competition begins.

videos.title: Amruta is injured, saving Virat
videos.overview: Anjali finds a gunpowder box at home and informs Amruta. Despite being stopped by Amruta, Virat breaks the pot and she gets injured while saving him from the blast. Later, Bhavani questions Priyanka.

videos.title: Amruta is out of danger
videos.overview: Bhavani is relieved when Amruta comes out of danger. Priyanka misbehaves with Babita, who wonders if she has made a mistake by bringing Priyanka home. Later, Virat tends to Amruta's wounds.

videos.title: Virat and Amruta go on a date
videos.overview: Virat asks Amruta to tell him the truth about the blast. Priyanka asks Virat to leave Amruta and come back to her. Rajiv comes out of jail. Later, Virat takes Amruta on a date to a special place.
